title: Getting the Board on Board: Marketing Department Power and Board Interlocks
eligible_reason: No eligible DiD. The key regressor is the continuous marketing department power of interlocked firms (a network peer-effect variable), estimated on a firm-year panel with an instrumental-variables strategy. No binary treatment switching on at unit-specific dates.
design_notes: Unbalanced firm-year panel (43,033 firm-years, 6,008 firms, 2007-2021) with Equilar interlock data and Compustat. Bayesian (Stan) linear-in-means panel IV model with four-digit SIC intercepts; endogeneity handled by lagged covariates and a control-function IV approach.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Licensed data (Equilar, Compustat). Excluded: continuous treatment, IV and no unit fixed effects.
